messages:
arya-shah: Hi everyone — Arya here, starting today on Systems (SRE). Super excited to join!

arya-shah: Quick setup questions: my MDM prompt says "Device not enrolled" even though I received the laptop from People Ops. Who should I ping for Okta/MDM enrollment? Also need access to dev VPC and the infra GitHub teams. And — are there any lunch plans today? :wave:

lia-chen: welcome aryA! :tada: tagging @people-ops and @it-bot — will DM you the onboarding checklist and calendar invites. For MDM follow the intranet guide and try `sudo profiles renew -type enrollment` if the prompt is stuck.

it-bot: IT ticket created: #IT-2445 — please DM your serial number (format SN-XXXX-XX). ETA for support is ~2 business hours.

samir-park: hey Arya — i'm your onboarding buddy. i'll add you to `infra-ops` and `eng-runtime` teams and send a GH invite. what's your GitHub username?

arya-shah: GitHub is @aryashah. thanks! Also can someone point me to the Dedicated capacity runbook? want to read up on GPU allocation and request flow.

kevin-cho: welcome! Dedicated runbook is at https://docs.redwood.ai/dedicated-runbook — short version: request in #dedicated-requests with `team`, `expected_qps`, and `SLO` fields. ping me if you want help drafting the first request.

people-ops: Arya — welcome again! Lunch: team is heading to the Korean BBQ at 12:30, meet in lobby. i've added parking and badge access.

it-bot: MDM enrollment completed for SN-4421-AR. Please reboot and confirm VPN/wiki access.

arya-shah: Rebooted — VPN and internal wiki are working now. Huge thanks! One more: who owns the onboarding sprint card for infra so I can see tasks assigned?

lia-chen: I created the onboarding card and assigned to @samir-park. Checklist items: `create ssh key`, `add to GitHub teams`, `request VPC access`, `SSO app approvals`.

samir-park: got it — i've scheduled a 30m pairing at 3pm to walk through alerting/playbooks and the first-run runbook. ping me in DMs if you want to move it earlier.

kevin-cho: if you hit noisy alerts while you're poking around, run `redwood status --filter infra` and DM me the output.

arya-shah: Awesome — thanks everyone, appreciate the warm welcome and help. Looking forward to diving in :rocket:
